text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um, Senpai! Isn't it way better to train 
together with someone?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like... I feel like we can grow way more 
than doing it alone! Right? ...Right!?!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I get it. When someone is right 
next to you, it makes you not want to 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right on~~~! I knew you were the type who 
gets fired up when you've got a worthy 
rival, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And so, Senpai!! For today only! I'm 
renting myself out to you, su!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's training or going out, I'll 
accompany you anywhere, Boss!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought, but... ...Why 
are you doing all this for me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? T-That's righttt! There's something I 
gotta say first, right...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
For doing this for me... thank you. 
Please, accompany me in training.
